title: Canonical derived scalar realization for a commutative condensed ring
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Reconstruct its commutative section-ring sheaf $A$ and the equivalence $e:\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda}\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ by [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence], using module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put $R=A(*)=\Gamma(*,\Lambda)$. The scalar map $c:\underline R\to A$ is the counit of constant sheafification adjoint to sections at the terminal profinite set: on a profinite set $S$, a scalar is restricted along $S\to *$. For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme] with small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and coefficient ring $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], define the scalar realization on the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] by the composite $D(R)\xrightarrow{\underline{(-)}}D(\underline R)\xrightarrow{Lc^*}D(A)\xrightarrow{D(e^{-1})}D(\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda})\xrightarrow{D(p_X^*)}D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_X)$. Here constant realization is [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] and $Lc^*$ is the universal derived change of rings of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], computed on K-flat representatives. This is $P\mapsto\Lambda_X\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\underline R}\underline P$ through the canonical constant-section map, with no flatness or boundedness hypothesis.
